speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this persistent cough and breathlessness, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about six weeks now, and the breathlessness has been getting worse lately, especially when I try to walk or climb stairs. It's actually quite uncomfortable at night too, often waking me up because I can't stop coughing. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.
